scope: Picture tests of 2026-10-27 on MedicineBow (one NVIDIA A30 or L40S per job): the developed-flow trend test (45 triples in five forms; three Gemma 4 models and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B), 4-bit Qwen with 1024 image tokens on two October 22 window sets, and a cylinder flow with random windows; the cylinder pimpleFoam and PODFoam runs. No solver run in the picture jobs.
notes: Sources are paths inside the archives of the release, or 'written for this folder'.
Files of kind gzip copy are gzip -9 copies (no name, mtime 0) of the named source; source_sha256 is the hash of the uncompressed bytes.
pictures/ holds PNG bytes decoded from the base64 image_url parts of the named request body.
truth.private.json means withheld from model input, not private personal information.
Original records contain cluster paths and server PIDs as provenance.
